message:
Plus dissertation angst. Can't forget that dissertation angst. And trucks. And prison. And, well, let me just go on and adapt David Allen Coe's [contention](http://www.leoslyrics.com/listlyrics.php?hid=Jbrh7z8zNUE%3D) (looks like I'm just referencing old country & western songs all over the place these days) that it won't be perfect unless Clancy says something about momma, and trains, and trucks, and prison, and gettin' drunk.:-)

I'll see if I can put another page of that comic up on Friday. Plot-wise, it *is* going somewhere, I promise; I've got six pages of panel breakdowns and dialogue -- it's the drawing that's the hard part.

Hope both of your semesters are wrapping up well -- don't stress *too* much, Clancy.
